_comment: Anti-inflation rules for headline counts in the report JSON (`metrics[]` and `counting_rules[]`), read by cti_report_sections.validate_metrics (build_report_data.py and the generators). A rule only WARNS — the numbers are never changed. Vocabulary only, never case data (RULE 1).

entity_terms._comment: Words in a metric label that make the reader assume one counted item = one real-world entity (a person, an account, a machine, a record).

non_entity_units._comment: Units of what was actually counted that are NOT one entity each: one account can own many tokens or credentials, one machine many log lines, one attack many chains.

attempted_terms._comment: Status / label words for an action that was tried but not shown to succeed.

confirmed_terms._comment: Status / label words for an outcome shown to have happened.

unit_fields._comment: Row keys read (in order) for WHAT a metric row counted.
